page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut ornament band. Then a centred title block in capitals and spaced type. Below, one text column with a large woodcut initial, and margin notes in the right margin beside the text. Faint show-through from the other side at the right edge is left out.

main_text.head: PETRI LOMBARDI EPISCOPI PARISIENSIS, IN LIBROS SENTENTIARUM, Prologus, in quo rationem sui instituti affert, atque huius operis vtilitatem & fundamenta docet.
main_text.p: Luc.21.a Mar.12.gVPIENTES, aliquid de penuria ac tenuitate nostra cum paupercula in gazophylacium domini mittere, ardua scandere, opus vltra vires nostras agere præsumpsimus, confummationis fiduciam, laborisque mercedem in Luc.10.fSamaritano statuentes, qui prolatis in curatione seminiui duobus denarijs supereroganti cuncta reddere professus est. Delectat nos veritas pollicentis : sed Ex Aug.7. lib. de Trinitate in proœmio.terret imminẽsitas laboris. Desiderium hortatur proficiendi, sed dehortatur infirmitas deficiendi, quam Cant.4.bvincit zelus domus Dei. Quo inardescentes, fidem nostram aduersus errores carnalium atque animalium hominum, Danidica turris clypeis munire, vel potius munitam ostendere, ac Theologicarum inquisitionum abdita aperire, necnon & sacramentorum Ecclesiasticorum pro modulo intelligentia nostra notitiam tradere studuimus. Non valetes studiosorum fratrum votis iure resistere, eorum in Christo laudabilibus studijs lingua acstylo nos seruire flagitantiu:

page.notes: Woodcut initial "V" with "PIENTES" joined; the printed initial is a decorated U/V shape. Marginal references: Luc.21.a; Mar.12.g; Luc.10.f; Ex Aug.7. lib. de Trinitate in proœmio.; Cant.4.b. Final word of the page printed as "flagitantiu:" with a small mark (x-like) below the last line, not transcribed as text. Some letters near the right edge are faint.
